findings.claim: Concurrent reservations can both succeed against the same stock, allowing more units to be promised than are available.
evidence: evals/cases/case_04/src/inventory.py:9-15 reads the available quantity, waits, and later writes a value derived from the stale read without any lock or atomic compare-and-update.

A runtime check using two threads to reserve one unit each from an initial stock of one produced two successful return values and a final available count of zero in all 20 attempts. This is a lost-update anomaly: two units were reported reserved while only one unit was deducted.
evals/cases/case_04/tests/test_inventory.py:4-8 exercises only one sequential reservation, so the passing test suite does not cover this concurrent failure mode.
